verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers AI-powered extraction (`ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules`) that lets AI derive semantic information from scraped pages, plus ChatGPT/Gemini API pass-through, which is the closest analog to 'AI-generated insights from data' in this product. However, there is no evidence of the product itself surfacing proactive insights/suggestions about a user's own account or usage data (e.g., a dashboard with AI recommendations) — the AI capability is scoped to extracting fields from target webpages, not analyzing the user's collected data set. Missing for 10: dashboard/account-level AI insight generation, proactive suggestions about the user's own stored data, evidence of AI summarizing trends across a user's scraped datasets.
